Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production character model and stance atlas for an original illustrated sci-fi animated-series opening, Ivan's Escape.
Input image is the existing Ivan face identity reference ONLY. Transform it into original hand-drawn 2D animation artwork, not photographic rendering. Preserve his short tousled black hair, narrow brown eyes, young adult angular face. Full body design: faded burnt orange plain waist-length jacket #C76A4B, charcoal crewneck shirt, dark trousers, worn off-white sneakers. Lean realistic stylized 7-head proportions. No accessories.
Create one wide landscape TRANSPARENT RGBA character turnaround atlas: exactly THREE isolated full-body figures, equally sized, fully visible head to soles with generous blank gutters, located in left third / center third / right third. Left: front three-quarter planted stance, reserved expression, facing slightly camera-left. Center: exact side profile facing right. Right: rear three-quarter facing away to right. Each identical Ivan, same height, same outfit. Clean transparent negative space behind and between all figures, no ground shadow or scenery or panel borders or lettering.
Art direction: confident selective ink contours, angular facial planes, exceptionally drawn hands, carefully designed garment folds, two or three broad cel-shadow values plus subtle painted edge texture, premium psychological sci-fi television opening illustration. Hard cool key from upper left, pale narrow rim, muted blue shadow planes. Jacket unmistakably burnt-orange, restrained natural eyes. Not chibi, not glossy 3D, not a photo, not plastic. Do not copy an existing anime character or costume. No weapons, armor, harness, jewelry, long hair or ponytail. No checkerboard baked into pixels.
